title: Monitoro
description: A lightweight, developer-first uptime monitoring service with Telegram bot alerts, real-time status pages, and incident management.
longDescription: Monitoro is the no-nonsense uptime monitoring tool built for indie developers and small teams. Set up monitoring in under 60 seconds — no dashboards to configure, no complex onboarding. Get instant Telegram alerts when your services go down, view historical uptime data, and share beautiful status pages with your users.
features: Public status pages with custom domains
